# useToastNotifications

Subscribes to typed backend toast notifications and delivers each generated identifier once.

## Usage

Call `useToastNotifications` during component setup and render the typed notification with your preferred toast library. StackTrace's Sonner component already includes this integration.

*Toaster.vue*

```typescript
import { useToastNotifications } from '@stacktrace/ui'
import { toast } from 'vue-sonner'

useToastNotifications(notification => {
  toast(notification.title, {
    description: notification.content || undefined,
    id: notification.id,
  })
})
```

## Notification contract

The callback receives `ToastNotification` directly from `@stacktrace/ui`. Applications do not need to augment Inertia's flash types for the built-in `toast` key.

```typescript
type ToastNotification = {
  id: string
  title: string
  content: string | null
  variant: 'default' | 'destructive'
}
```

## Deduplication

The PHP Toast facade generates an identifier for every notification. The composable remembers the latest 500 identifiers for the lifetime of the loaded application and ignores repeated responses carrying one of them.

## API Reference

### `useToastNotifications`

Runs a callback once for each identified backend toast notification.

```typescript
function useToastNotifications(
  callback: (notification: ToastNotification) => void,
): void
```

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `callback` (required) | `(notification: ToastNotification) => void` | Receives each typed backend notification after identifier deduplication. |

#### Returns

`void` — The composable manages the flash subscription through the component lifecycle.

Hosted documentation: [useToastNotifications](https://ui.stacktrace.sk/docs/composables/toast-notifications)
